title: Use one selected comparison across every read surface
preconditions: A committed feature branch can be compared with main.

steps.expected_result: Status reports compare mode with the selected base, head, and resolved object IDs.

steps.action: Read the query overview with the same --against value.
steps.expected_result: The query reports the same mode, base, head, and object IDs as status.

steps.action: Open the reviewer change endpoint with the same comparison.
steps.expected_result: The visible comparison names the same head, base, and merge-base.

expected_result: Status, structured queries, and the reviewer are scoped by one identical selected comparison.
